title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 6300 N. Northwest Highway in Chicago, Illinois, as the "Officer Joseph P. Cali Post Office Building".
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 6300 N. Northwest Highway in Chicago, Illinois, as the "Officer Joseph P. Cali Post Office Building."

summary.headline: A law that names a Chicago post office building after Officer Joseph P. Cali.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames a United States Postal Service facility at 6300 N. Northwest Highway in Chicago, Illinois, as the "Officer Joseph P. Cali Post Office Building." It is an honorary naming measure. It does not change postal services, rules, or costs.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: It took effect when it was signed into law on December 16, 2016.
